name: Yamato Nadeshiko o Sagase!
source:
Main character is a university assistant immersed in Yamato Nadeshiko research. His former professor invents a time machine, and protagonist goes to the past to make Yamato Nadeshiko his girlfriend.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名沉浸於大和撫子研究的大學助教。他的前任教授發明了一臺時間機器，主角回到過去，想讓大和撫子成為他的女朋友。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]］
